source.extraction: Unchanged public onChange API body, wrapped only as a JavaScript expression. Offsets use UTF-16 character indices in the decoded original asset.

verifiedScope: Execute the actual subscription adapter with fake form and config dependencies; verify exact value forwarding and native detail handling. This fixture does not instantiate the complete React form or prove browser lifecycle behavior.

staticEvidence.name: public-set-value
staticEvidence.interpretation: The public setter passes its value to the native internal setter.

staticEvidence.name: internal-set-value
staticEvidence.interpretation: Existing field values flow through updateFormItemProps.

staticEvidence.name: programmatic-change
staticEvidence.interpretation: The native property writer invokes the form value callback for programmatic values.

staticEvidence.name: field-change-subscribers
staticEvidence.interpretation: The form value callback invokes field and form custom change subscribers; this is static chain evidence, not an end-to-end runtime test.

staticEvidence.name: runtime-container
staticEvidence.interpretation: initRuntime allocates this per-runtime container; a namespaced initialization marker belongs here, with the current native form identity checked by the caller.

staticEvidence.name: runtime-form-identity
staticEvidence.interpretation: The runtime retains the native form reference separately from business values.

staticEvidence.name: form-config-clone
staticEvidence.interpretation: getFormConfigs returns a clone; callers must not use it as a persistent registration marker.

limits: The public onChange adapter discards the native registration return handle; no unsubscribe contract is exposed here.
Repeated registrations append subscriptions; generated initialization needs a per-form, per-pair guard.
The adapter requires a resolved field config and is not a public global change subscription.
Desktop and mobile subscription adapters are independently captured and executed; the complete React form lifecycle and rendered interaction are outside these fixture tests.
